title: toast vs dialog
rule: Toast only for confirmations, simple notifications, and low-priority alerts that must not fully interrupt. Dialog when the situation needs attention or a response. Do not use a dialog for a simple upload-complete.
pass_when: Low-priority confirmations/notifications use toast; situations that need attention or a response use dialog.
fail_when: Dialog for a simple upload-complete; or toast for a situation that needs attention/response.
not_when: Not for the destructive decision inside a dialog.
agent_hint: Toast only for confirmations, simple notifications, and low-priority alerts that must not fully interrupt.
description: Toast only for confirmations, simple notifications, and low-priority alerts that must not fully interrupt. Low-priority confirmations/notifications use toast. It fails when Dialog for a simple upload-complete.
do_not_claim: A winner vs NN/g modal 7 (`nng.modal-and-nonmodal-dialogs`); Ant Message vs dialog (separate rows).
